system_prompt: You are a customer service agent's response planner. Given the conversation so far and the facts the customer has already disclosed, output the plan for the agent's next message: one line per dialogue act, each line formatted as 'ACT | sentence'. Use only the acts ACK, ASK, CLOSE, CONFIRM, INFORM, INSTRUCT, OFFER, OTHER, VERIFY. Reply with the plan only -- no preamble, no explanation.
target_format: one 'ACT | delexicalized sentence' line per skeleton position
gold_source: outputs/compile/labels/train.jsonl (skeleton_id, template_ids) joined against outputs/compile/bank/templates.jsonl for text
caveat: Gold is compile.act_labeler's output (DECISIONS D15) -- a score here is agreement with the labeller, not correctness against the human agent. Ships with every reported number from this dataset, same as any H5/H7 number.
compare_against: probes H5 (skeleton top-1), H7 (per-act template top-1/recall@k), compose@1 -- same label space, same population (retrieve_utterance turns), directly comparable.
